The camera movement starts by establishing spatial context before gradually increasing the pace of question-and-answer exchanges. shot1: Shot 1 opens with a fade-in, using a wide overhead perspective. The composition uses the circular track and floating platform to create strong leading lines. In the foreground, floating neon signs and reporter vehicles pass by; in the background, the slowly rotating starfield and space station structure are visible through the viewport. Cool purple-blue neon evenly illuminates the metallic floor with slight backlighting edges. The protagonist concept car is parked at a distance on the central floating platform, while the host car and multiple reporter cars glide into position along the track. The camera performs a fast sweeping pan followed by a slight downward tilt.
shot2: Shot 2 cuts hard from the previous shot, transitioning to a full shot at eye level. The host car drives along a glowing track onto the floating stage. The frame uses symmetrical composition, with the spotlight on the podium and the vehicle silhouette forming visual focus. A mechanical microphone arm rises automatically in the foreground. Reporter cars respond with brief flashes of their headlights.
shot3: Shot 3 cuts via matching action to a close-up at eye level, focusing on the protagonist concept car as the main subject. A blurred microphone is extended toward it in the foreground, with floating screens and blurred reporter car lights in the background. Shallow depth of field emphasizes the front speaker module and sleek body. Neon reflects off the glossy paint. The protagonist car slightly lifts its front end and responds confidently with “星际续航一万公里”. The camera performs a delicate push-in to intensify the moment of information release.
shot4: Shot 4 cuts hard with a reverse angle from the previous shot, switching to a medium over-the-shoulder view from behind a reporter car looking at the protagonist concept car. The reporter car’s window frame and antenna serve as foreground elements, maintaining continuous background logic of the space station venue. The reporter car quickly extends half its body forward, steadily passing the microphone and asking “安全呢”. Its speaker module opens and closes more rapidly and urgently. The protagonist car pauses briefly across the way, dimming its lights slightly to show attentiveness. The camera subtly moves forward to match the pressure of the follow-up question.
shot5: Shot 5 transitions via a slight push cut into a close-up low-angle shot, focusing on the protagonist car’s headlights, front face, and speaker area. The background is darkened to blurred neon and starfield points. Cold highlights appear on the metal surface with a soft backlight edge. The protagonist car’s headlights first flicker slightly before speaking “陨石规避已实测”. Headlight flashes sync with the stress in “已实测”. The reporter car’s microphone head trembles slightly at the edge of the frame. The camera performs an extremely short push-in to amplify the confident response and product credibility.
shot6: Shot 6 cuts with a whip pan from the previous shot, arriving at a medium-wide side view. Multiple reporter cars are neatly aligned in side-row track seats. The horizontal lineup creates rhythmic composition. Mechanical microphone arms rise layer by layer in both foreground and background. In the depth of field, the protagonist concept car is visible at the far center. Uniform neon top lighting and ground reflections maintain a cool futuristic aesthetic. Multiple reporter cars simultaneously raise their mechanical microphones, headlights flash frequently, wheels adjust slightly, and listener postures shift to actively compete for speaking rights. On-site emotion clearly intensifies.
shot7: Shot 7 cuts hard with consistent spatial direction to a wide overhead shot, filming the audience area from above. Circular seating and glowing tracks form a radial composition. In the foreground, several audience cars lean forward slightly. In the background, the protagonist concept car is visible on the central floating stage. The scene remains dominated by cool purple-blue neon and cold starlight from outside the viewport. A visible stir occurs in the audience area. One audience car near the aisle raises a small microphone and asks “何时量产”. Surrounding vehicles’ lights flash in chain reaction. The camera slowly tilts down, and the commotion and question echo slightly within the space station dome.
shot8: Shot 8 connects smoothly via a lateral dolly move from the previous shot, returning the camera from the audience area to the protagonist concept car. Using a medium eye-level shot, several hovering microphones sweep past in the foreground, while the starfield and large illuminated logo of the event are visible in the background. The protagonist car slightly turns its body toward the questioner, its light strip curving into a human-like smile, clearly answering “明年启航”. Reporter and audience cars on both sides show noticeable nodding-like body movements in response. The camera continues panning and then gently stops, giving the answer a definitive conclusion effect typical of a press conference.
shot9: Shot 9 transitions via a fade into a full shot at eye level, shifting the scene to the group photo area in front of the viewport. The protagonist concept car is centered, with the host car and reporter cars arranged in a semi-circular arc on either side. Several partially retracted mechanical mics and floating drones are in the foreground. The massive viewport and slowly moving nebula form the background. The primary neon lighting remains consistent, with only a soft backlight added at the viewport edge. All vehicles briefly stabilize. Their headlights flash in sequence. At the moment of the photo, the protagonist car maintains a polite smile, while reporter cars slightly move closer. The camera first pulls back slightly, then gently elevates.
shot10: Shot 10 continues with a slow pull-out from the previous shot, cutting back to a wide low-angle slightly eye-level concluding perspective. The central floating stage, circular audience area, and starfield outside the viewport are all included in the frame. Composition centers the protagonist concept car as the glowing focal point. Reporter and audience cars gradually quiet down. Cool purple-blue neon casts long reflections on the metallic floor. The last character of “位” floats into the starfield with a lingering echo from the amplification system. The camera continuously pulls back and slightly ascends, shrinking the venue into a bright node in the cosmos.
